tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang*/ 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan gnyis med ye shes rdo rje'i thugs ni mchog tu bde bas kun tu rnam rol zhing*// ma rig thibs po'i tshogs sel de las byung ba'i bdud rnams 'jig byed nyes kun 'joms pa'i dpal// bcom ldan dpal chen bla ma mchog dang gnyis su med pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mor phyag 'tshal nas// de yi go 'phang thob bya'i don du de nyid las ni dbang rab blang ba'i cho ga bshad// dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs shing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ bsnyen pa sngon du song bas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su tshom bu bkod pa bam̐ las sa'i lha mo ser mo phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas dpang po khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin par bskyed pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bskyed la/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang*/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis gtor ma phul la/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde// pham par byas nas dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum gyis mkhyen par gsol nas gnang ba byin par bsam mo// slar yang mchod nas/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol lo// sa bslang ba'o// de nas lag pa gnyis kyis dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi dang*/

khor yug thams cad bcag cing*/ lag mthil las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sa'i ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// yang bcag cing*/ oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod cing*/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam pa ni sa sbyang ba'o// de nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug la/ srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod nas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub bo snyam du blos bzung ba ni sa'i cho ga'o// de nas dus bzang po la bab pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi byi dor byas pa la mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma la sogs pas bskor zhing yo byad thams cad bsags nas/ sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma btang la yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ lha yi rnal 'byor bsgoms la bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya'o// de nas mchod rdzas rnams nye snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge gsum las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa bskyed la/ so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa'i sa chog ltar bya'o// de nas ba byung dri bzangs bdud rtsi dang sbyar bas dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar nas/ g.yas phyogs su khye ma med par byug cing*/ oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ gis rdo rje'i sa gzhir byin gyis brlabs/ der skad cig gis srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bskyed pa'i dbus dang*/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog cung zad re bkod la/ dbus su skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das yum dang bcas pa dang*/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du ha ha zhes drag tu dgod pa'i ro langs chen po brgyad bskyed nas sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// de nas phyi nang yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod cing bstod pa rnams kyis bstod nas/

gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das/ gnyis pa chos skyong*/ gsum pa phyogs skyong bcu/ bzhi pa gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po// lnga pa gzhi'i bdag po rnams la dbul lo// de nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni// rig sngags bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod// snying rje'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor bri// de phyir byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod// dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs// gang gzhan sngags kyi lha tshogs dang*// lha rnams bstan la mngon dga' ba// dkyil 'khor 'di la byin rlabs dang*// dngos grub dam pa stsol bar mdzod// ces lan gsum du mkhyen par gsol bas ci dga' bgyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo// lha sta gon no// de nas mngon par bshams pa'i bum pa gnyis bsangs shing sbyangs nas/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis brgyan par bskyed la/ rnam rgyal gyi bum par mngon byang lnga las bcom ldan 'das yab yum dang*/ las thams cad bar yang mngon byang lnga las bgegs mthar byed nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje gdengs pa dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pa bskyed nas/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar du bya ste/ bgegs mthar byed la don yod grub pa'o// de la mchod cing bstod nas/ bdag gi snying ga nas spros pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas rgyud bskul nas/ sku'i cha thams cad las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rī dang*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs pa bzlas nas mchod cing bstod la dung chos kyi chu blugs pas lha zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chur blta'o// bum pa sta gon no// de nas phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir tshogs kyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/

slar yang tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod la/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ badz+ro t+tiṣ+ṭhas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg la bzhugs su gsol lo// sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga'o// nang par bris pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i mtha' mar mchod pa dang gtor ma la sogs pa'i rgyan nye bar bkram nas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'i bar sta gon ltar bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor/ yang snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sra zhing brtan pa'i steng du/ bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer phar 'phros snod thams cad gzhal yas khang par bsgyur/ slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang zhing*/ dbus khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor thod pa skam po'i rwa ba keng rus kyis phub cing*/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re dang*/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi byas pa/ khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du bcom ldan 'das bdag bskyed ji lta ba bzhin bsgom par bya ste/ 'on kyang yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog nag mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ sgo mtshams brgyad du bhaiṃ gyi yi ge gyur pa las lce brkyang zhing ha ha zhes drag tu dgod cing langs pa'i ro langs chen po brgyad dang*/ grwa rnams su bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa brgyad bsgom mo// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi skye mched dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/

suṃ bha'i sngags brjod cing*/ rdo rje gsor bas srung ba'i 'khor lo kha phye la/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i lha mo rnams spros pas/ sta gon gyi lha dam tshig pa la dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du byas par bsam zhing*/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān badz+ra bhai ra wā ya/ zhes 'og ma gsum la sbyar la/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes brjod do// yang rang dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'jam pa'i dbyangs// khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs// 'jam dpal khro bo mi bzad pa// mthu rtsal drag po gshegs su gsol// zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ e h+ye hi la sogs pa'i mthar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs spyan drangs/ mchod cing bstod nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ me tog gtor zhing*/ 'dir bzhugs 'dir bzhugs 'jam pa'i dbyangs// khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs// 'jam dpal khro bo mi bzad pa// mthu rtsal drag po bzhugs su gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ sngar gyi cho gas bstim pas/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gyur par bsgom/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsdams/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya la sogs pa lan gsum brjod do// dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'o// de nas mchod yon la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su la sogs pa yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod nas/ bstod pa rnams kyis bstod la sta gon ltar gtor ma dbul lo// mchod pa'o// de nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi shar du 'dug nas/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pas cho ga rnams mdzad la/ las rnams de'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i ya mān+ta ka phyag gnyis pas mdzad par bsam zhing*/ rang gi las rnams rang gis dngos su bya'o// de nas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ ro langs ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// zhes pa la sogs pa nas/ gshin rje sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor du// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing zhing*/ u dum bā ra dang man+da ra// yongs 'du dang ni mal+li ka /kar+ṇi ka yi phreng ba 'di// legs par nos te bus zung shig /ces pas me tog gtad pa blang*/ oṃ a bigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum pas bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ bdud rtsi myangs pas byin gyis brlab/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes dris pa'i lan du/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la dga'o// zhes lan gdab/ des bu la ci zhig bya'i lan du/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes brjod do// de nas rang gi snying gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dmigs pa'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse mo lnga pa don dam pa byang chub kyi sems su dmigs nas dngos su rdo rjes gtug cing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ spyi bor rdo rje gtugs la/ dus 'di nas ni khyod nyid ni// sangs rgyas rigs su chud pas na// nga yis rdo rje ye shes sbyin// de yis sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur// gang zhig 'di nyid ma mthong ba'i// mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /bag med smras na nyams par 'gyur// de bas nan tan gnas par byos// zhes gsang bar gdams nas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i sgo ba bzhis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor khrid par bsams nas/

na masti hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo nā ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi phyag gsum bya// oṃ badz+rota gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas sgo rnams phye nas shar sgo nas gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyi byin gyis brlab du gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pas+thā nā ya/ āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta āt+ma mo hān+ta kṛ ta a dhiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ lho phyogs nas phra ma gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis dbang bskur bar gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta āt+ma pi shu nān+ta kṛ ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ nub phyogs nas 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis chos ston par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra warta nā ya/ āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta āt+ma ra gān+ta kṛ ta dhārma tsakra pra warta na ya māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ byang phyogs nas phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal kyis phrin las bsgrub par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma naṃ/ āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta ga āt+ma ir+ṣ+yān+ta kṛ ta karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ de nas 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal gyis dngos grub thams cad gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta swa bhā wa badz+ra ā tsār+ya pā da naṃ ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ sarba sid+dhi/ pra yats+tshan+tu māṃ/ zhes pas phyag lnga bya'o// de nas// dkon mchog gsum la bdag bskyabs mchi// la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad la sogs pa sdom pa gzung ba rnams lan gsum gsum byas nas/ thob pa'i dam tshig mi nyams par bsrung du gzhug pa'i phyir/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/

dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya'i khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes bsrungs pa'i phan yon dang*/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas/ gshin rje gshed dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// nga yis bstan pa'i gsang ba 'di// dam tshig med pa'i mi rnams dang*// gang yang gzhan la smras gyur na// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ mna' chu byin nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'gyur// 'thung shig rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu// oṃ pañca a mṛ to da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥzhes phan yon dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dang*/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi// gshin rje'i gshed po nga yin gyis// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa// khyod kyis skyo ba med par gyis// gang yang nga la brnyas par min// de bzhin mos pa ma byas na// bdud kyis bcom nas dmyal bar 'gro// de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis// zhes rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag par bsam mo// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig dpal gshin rje gshed bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ badz+ra bhai ra wa phyag gnyis par bsgoms pa'i rkang mthil du/ dzhaiṃ me'i rang bzhin snying gar sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ snying gi nang du 'jam dpal gzhon nu/

mgrin par chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po āḥs mtshan pa/ spyi bor rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po has mtshan par bsams nas/ 'og gi rlung g.yos pas rkang mthil gyi me sbar bas lus thams cad gang*/ sdig pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsregs/ snying ga'i sa dmar por tshig mgrin pa'i chu bskol/ mgo bo'i rlung gis mnan/ rkang pa'i rlung gis bteg me'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par char bzhin du bab pas thim par bsam zhing*/ gu gul la sogs pa'i rdzas kyis kyang bdugs la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rī'i mthar/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya ā be sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ raḥraḥtsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ aḥha dzhaiṃ zhes yang yang gsungs par bsams nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya'o// de nas bla mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// gshin rje gshed dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bden pa'i stobs gsungs nas/ oṃ ma hā pū dza pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas me tog gi phreng ba bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor du dbul/ des kyang pra tī gṛh+ṇa swa mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la oṃ/ zhes gsungs nas spyi bor gnang bar bsam/ de nas mig 'bras gnyis oṃ du bsgoms nas/ gshin rje gshed po ding khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhes gsung zhing gdong g.yogs bkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu ma hā maṇ+ḍal pra be sha ya phaṭa/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu'i dngos// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gang rtogs zhing khams rnam dag mchog

/bla na med pa'i gnas mchog yin// rdo rje thugs rje'i rgyun gnas pas// sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyun mi chad// bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis mthong*// phun sum tshogs kun 'dir 'grub 'gyur// dngos grub bsgrub phyir dam tshig skyongs// gsang sngags don la brtson par gyis// zhes pas dkyil 'khor bstan pa bltas la dkyil 'khor dngos su mthong bar bsgom pa ni 'jug pa'o// yang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ ji ltar rdo rje chos chen pos// rdo rje sems dpar dbang bskur ba// de bzhin bdag la'ang dbang bskur zhing*// bdag la don mchog stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo drung du/ rin po che'i khri chen po pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'i spyi bor gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang phyogs thams cad du mchod pa'i sprin bkram pas rang la mchod cing bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i rigs lngas bum pa'i chus khrus gsol/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'i lha mos mchod par bsam zhing*/ dngos su yang bkra shis brjod pa ni sngon du 'gro ba'o// de nas dbang thams cad kyi sngon du swa bhā was stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid dhīḥlas 'jam dpal gzhon nu gser gyi mdog can/ ral gri dang pu sti ut+pa la dang bcas pa 'dzin par bskyed do// de'i thugs ka dang rnam rgyal gyi bum par ya las rdo rje yas mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ ye shes pa bstim/ snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur bsam/

dbang gi lha rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis ji ltar bltams pa la sogs pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca su ra ti s+t+waṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ dri ma thams cad dag mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ nang gi dbang gi don du/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// thugs kyi rdo rjer mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas 'od sngon po byung*/ rang gi lus thams cad yongs su sbyangs/ 'od kyi lam nas zhal du zhugs/ snying gar 'od du zhu/ thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed du bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang de nyid kyi rnam pas bstim/ bha ga nas phyir 'phros nas rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ tshul 'di dag 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar bar bya'o// chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o// yang bdag gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng dang*/ dbu rgyan ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum du bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs/ dbang rdzas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa zhu ba las byung ba'i cod paṇa du bsam/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi cod paṇa dbang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid rab bsgrub phyir// cod paṇa mchog gi dbang bskur bas// 'khor los sgyur rgyal mgon dbang bskur/ oṃ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tām̐ hūm̐/ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ gis cod paṇa dang*/ chus kyang dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dpal ldan yon tan rdo rje 'dzin la sogs pa dang*/ yon tan rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig

/ces gsol ba gdab/ yum gyi bha gar phra ma gshin rje gshed du gyur/ ye shes pa bstim/ rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la mchod nas/ cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o// yang bdag gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng dang*/ rdo rje me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa las 'od dpag med yab yum du bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs/ dbang rdzas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bsam/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas lha rnams kyis/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje mchog gi dbang bskur bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca yā mis rdo rje dang*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan// la sogs pa nas/ gsung gi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig gis gsol ba gdab/ yum gyi bha gar 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du gyur/ ye shes pa bstim/ rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la mchod nas/ rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o// yang rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng dang*/ dril bu da las ral gri das mtshan pa las phrag dog gshin rje gshed yab yum du bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs/ dbang rdzas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa de zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur bsam/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis chos kyi dril bu bla med don// stong nyid ye shes sgra sgrogs pa'i// thams cad stong nyid don ston pa'i// dril bu'i dbang bskur bla na med// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shap+da pa ta l+ye dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣe ka ta shri ye sa ma ya hūm̐ gis dril bu dang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/

don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dpal ldan phrin las rdo rje 'dzin// la sogs pa nas/ phrin las rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig gis gsol ba gdab/ yum gyi bha gar phrag dog gshin rje gshed du gyur/ ye shes pa bstim/ rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la mchod nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o// yang rang gi snying ga'i nyi ma'i steng du/ k+ṣe las 'khor lo k+ṣes mtshan pa las 'od spro bsdu bya zhing yongs su gyur pas rnam par snang mdzad yab yum du bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i ming*// de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya// oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra a bhi ṣe ka ta shri ye sa ma ya hūm̐/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes ming dang chus kyang dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku 'chang ba// la sogs pa dang*/ sku yi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig gis gsol ba gdab/ yum gyi bha gar gti mug gshin rje gshed du gyur/ ye shes pa bstim/ rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la mchod nas/ ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o// de nas rang nyid rigs lnga ka'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa yum rdo rje snyems ma dang gnyis su med par bsgoms pa la dbang gi lhas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin las grub pa'i rdo rje gnang ba/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/

e ṣa dha ra yā mi/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing snying gar bzung nas/ snying gi nang du yang rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa ni/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs te/ slob ma'i dbang ngo*// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ kye ho khyod kyi bka' drin gyis// bdag la rang dang gzhan gyi don// rdzogs phyir rdo rje slob dpon dbang*// snying rje'i gter gyis stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rang nyid 'jam dpal du bsgoms pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor bar bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje gsum du bdag sgrubs shig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi bha gar babs pa'i rdo rje 'chang sngon po yum dang bcas par gyur/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// skye mched kyang byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bskur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ ro gcig par byas te bha ga nas 'phros nas dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnas pa la/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyis/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// la sogs pa sngags dang bcas pas rdo rje gnang*/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje'i de kho na nyid gsung zhing thugs kyi dam tshig dang*// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces pas g.yon par dril bu gnang nas/

a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ zhes dril bu'i de kho na nyid gsung zhing gsung gi dam tshig dang*/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// zhes rjes su gnang ba byin nas yum la 'khyud pa'i tshul du byas pa la/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung*// sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir// shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs// dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu zung*// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du// rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// 'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i// phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su bsgrags// yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro// zhes phyag rgya'i dam tshig rgyas par gsungs nas bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa la/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyis su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes gsung zhing me tog gi char phab nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' phul bar bsam mo// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// de nas gzhal yas khang pa ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa lam gyi chos rnam par dag pa yin la/ dur khrod ni lus dang 'jig rten gyi chos rnam par dag pa yin zhing srung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'o// zhes dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang*/ lha rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang*/ yon tan dang phrin las rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo'o// zhes lha'i de kho na nyid dang*/ de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dang gsung dang thugs la tshang ngo*// zhes slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid gsung bar bsam mo// de kho na nyid do// de nas rang nyid zhi ba'i sku las khro bo'i skur yongs su rdzogs par bskyed/

sku gsung thugs dang skye mched byin gyis brlab/ dbang mdor bsdus te bskur nas ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas pa ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas me tog phreng ba thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas rang gi zhal du zhugs pa snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mtha' mar bkod par bsam zhing*/ gsung gi rjes su gnang bar bsams la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying lan gsum gsum dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes bzlas nas/ me tog phul bas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs nas phreng ba spyi bor bzhag pa ni sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba'o// sdug pa'i gdong du bltas nas ni// bltas par gyur pa'i bde ba de// sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni// skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur// bud med kun gyis yongs bskor la// kun nas rtses pa'i bde ba de// sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni// skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur// dge 'am yang na mi dge ba'i// las rnams byas pa gang yin pa// sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni// skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur// zhes mchod pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ mchog gi dngos grub thams cad ni// brtul zhugs mchog gis bsgrub par bya// de phyir gshin rje 'joms pa yi// brtul zhugs rnam pa kun tu spyod// phal cher dngos grub mchog rnams ni// brtul zhugs med pas mi 'grub pas// gshin rje 'joms pa'i brtul zhugs 'di// legs spyod mchog gi dngos su bsgrubs// zhes pas brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ ji ltar dbang bskur la sogs pas// sangs rgyas la sogs thob pa bzhin// byang chub spyod tshogs gzhan dag dang*// 'dul sogs dge bas de lta min// de bas dam tshig bus srungs shig

/rtag tu sdom pa yang bsrung ngo*// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' ste// de las gzhan pa'i dam tshig srungs// dkon mchog gnod pa gsad bya zhing*// bud med kun la spyad par bya// pha rol nor ni blang bya zhing*// rtag tu brdzun gyi tshig kyang smros// rnal 'byor rgyus las gang gsungs pa// de yang cho ga bzhin du srungs// zhes pa dam tshig gi rjes gnang dang*// khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// kun tu dri med gang bar gyis// zhes dung dang*/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus par// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// de bzhin du rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ zhes chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje gnang nas/ zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba ste// nad la sogs pa zhi bar bya// rgyas pa'i sems kyis rgyas pa ste// rin chen char sprin rab bskor bya// rjes su chags pa'i sems kyis ni// dbang gi las ni yang dag sgrubs// gsad pa'i sems kyis drag po ste// me yi char sprin dbab par bya// zhes pas phrin las bzhi'i rjes gnang dang*/ kham̐ las bskyed pa'i ye shes kyi ral gri byin nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che// khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa// las kyi ral gri gcig pu mchog /bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir zung*// oṃ badz+ra khaḍ+ga hūm̐/ zhes pas khyad par du drag po'i phrin las kyi rjes gnang dang*/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil l+h+wam de bzhin ri lu ste// rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub ni// de ni ci dgar bsgrub par gyis// zhes pas dngos grub kyi rjes gnang mdzad par bsam pa ni rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas bla mas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bdag gi spyi bor gtugs nas/

'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// gshin rje gshed dpal de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum du bhur+bhu wa swaḥ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis byang chub chen por mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no// zhes lung bstan par bsam mo// 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyis nam yang ma yin no// ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags// sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas// dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris// khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su// sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor// sngags bshad tshul gyi cho ga yis// skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*// khyod la rtag tu srung bar mdzad// ces pas dbugs dbyung*/ de ring khyod bdag legs par rnyed// mi yi srid pa don dang bcas// sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skyes// sems nyid rin chen 'byung ba'i gter// phun sum tshogs pa nye bar gnas// gsang sngags mnyam med sems las grub// zag med bde ba'i dkyil 'khor che// mthong ba'am ni zhugs gyur pas// sdig pa kun las rnam par grol// byang chub sems mchog rmad byung rnyed// 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas mchog /bdud bzhi 'joms shing sdug bsngal gyi// skye rga na 'chi 'jig par byed// srid pa ngo bo nyid dag pas// phyag na rdo rjer da gyur to// zhes gzengs bstod do// phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/

lus kyi dri ma dag bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ sprul pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o// bum pa'i dbang thob/ de nas bla ma longs skur dmigs pa la gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ gdong g.yogs bcing zhing 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas thams cad zhal du zhugs thugs kar 'od du zhu/ gsang ba'i gnas nas phyung nas/ btung ba rin chen dam pa 'di// rdo rje'i lus ni rab sgrub byed// bu khyod de ltar shes gyis la// yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung shig /ces gsungs nas/ lce thog tu gnang ba a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod de/ mid pas lus thams cad gang zhing*/ ngag gi dri ma dag nas/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du gyur par bsgoms la/ gdong g.yogs phye ste bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag rang byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ longs sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o// gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// de nas bla ma chos sku dmigs pa la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ shes rab ye shes dbang bskur stsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ gdong g.yogs bcings/ 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ rang dpal chen por dmigs pa la/ gzungs ma 'di ni yid 'ong ma// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis dgongs// 'khor lo'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis// zhes pas/ rdo rje ro langs ma gnang ba dang*/ des/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mor 'o byed pa// bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam// zhes dris pa'i lan du/

ci gsung dam tshig bsten par ni// lha mo bdag ni spro gyur to// zhes lan gdab pa dang*/ lha mo des bha ga'i dkyil 'khor bstan nas/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas// gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten pa// de yi mdun na nga gnas te// sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa// pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// twaṃ bhañja mok+ṣa ho/ zhes brjod nas pang du byon pa dang*/ slar yang gnyis ka'i sku gsal btab/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs/ gnas lngar yi ge 'bru lnga dgod/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas snyam pa'i 'du shes kyis snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsams la sems gzung ngo*// de nas gdong g.yogs phye la/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgoms pa la dbang*/ chos kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// de nas bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi skur dmigs pa la dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bzhi pa yang ni stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ gdong g.yogs bcing*/ byin gyis brlab/ bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs dang ldan pa la/ brtan g.yo'i dngos po ma lus pa// bsgom par bya ba'i dus nyid na// blos ni yongs su mi bsgom ste// kun gyi mtshan nyid mi shes na// de kho na nyid bsgom min te// dngos po thams cad yongs shes na// de ni bsgom par yongs su bsgrags// zhes gsungs pa'i don spros bral gyi ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /de nas gdong g.yogs phye la/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa la dbang*/

ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas snyam du bsam mo// dbang bzhi pa'o// de nas lus dang longs spyod thams cad yon du phul la/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// de nas dbang blang ba'i yul dang*/ len pa po dang*/ len pa'i tshul gsum ka rang bzhin med par sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i ngang nas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung*// de bzhin de nyid nges par byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod do// de nas phyi nang gi lha mchod pa'i phyir/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la mchod cing bstod de/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ji ltar 'dod pa rnams gsol ba btab nas/ las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ bsngo ba dang smon lam yang rgya cher btab la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa yang brjod de/ dkyil 'khor la ma bstim pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ oṃ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol lo// ras ris kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim pa ni rab tu gnas pa mchog tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol nas/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol la/ gtor ma nyid kyang rol mo dang bcas pas gtang ste/

bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum bsrungs nas las kyi rjes bsdus te/ gnas skabs dang rjes su 'brel pa'i rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o// de ltar rtag tu dbang lam du byas pas gnas skabs su bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal nas/ tshe dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs par 'gyur la/ srid pa thams cad du rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i go 'phang mchog thob ste/ sa dang lam thams cad bde blag tu bgrod nas/ rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po nyid kyi go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ro// rgyal rigs gzhon nu chos la thugs gsal dpal 'byor phun tshogs lcags mtshan 'chang bas bskul ba'i ngor// ngo mtshar rmad byung 'bras bu nyer 'byin cho ga'i rim pa 'phags pas sbyar las dge ba gang*// nye bar bskrun pa dge ba kun dang rnam par 'dres nas sems can kun la rab khyab ste// thams cad thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid gyur cig /dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing*/ dbang blang ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba chu mo bya'i lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes nyi shu dgu la shing kun du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
